master_refs.core: core.py Design B: F, WM, G, KI
master_refs.g0_source: Shao et al. Optica 6, 1498 (2019) Table S2: g0/2pi = 1.1 kHz

symbol_map.G_core: gamma (bus external coupling of ring 1), rad/s
symbol_map.kappa: G + KI = loaded decay of ring 1, rad/s
symbol_map.n_th_C0: upper bound: spontaneous scattering into SAME acoustic mode relative to one intracavity photon (not a full multimode calculation)
symbol_map.term1_n_th_over_Ncoh: drive-jitter / incoherent coupling fluctuation (kept from make_all; NOT deleted)

term1_drive_jitter.note: Unchanged from results_B.json thermal; incoherent coupling fluctuation only.

term2_spontaneous_same_mode.definition: C0 = 4 g0^2 / (kappa gamma_m) with all rates in rad/s. n_th*C0 upper-bounds spontaneous scattering mediated by the SAME driven acoustic mode, relative to a single intracavity photon. It is NOT a claim of multimode leakage to other optical modes, NOT a measured noise floor, and NOT a quantum-advantage metric.

comparison.verdict_zh: 室温下 n_th·C0 仍远小于未滤波边带误差 1−η_shift；自发散射上界不主导；与驱动抖动项同属可忽略量级。

non_claims: Not a measurement; simulation/order-of-magnitude bound only.
Does not model spontaneous scattering into OTHER optical modes (different spatial/spectral channels); that channel remains unquantified here.
Does not claim quantum advantage, fab readiness, or Fiber-Q relevance (N/A).
g0 is a literature input from Shao 2019, not remeasured on Design B geometry.
